# Security

This simulator produces synthetic data and must never control a real machine.
Keep S7, MQTT, OPC UA and administration endpoints on loopback or an authorized
private test network. Do not publish credentials, certificates with private keys,
or runtime databases in issues or pull requests.

For sensitive vulnerabilities, use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting when
available. Do not disclose credentials or exploitable deployment details publicly.
The 24-hour soak remains NOT RUN until recorded evidence demonstrates completion.
